High-Tolerance Spacer Rings

Thick-walled spacer rings and yokes. Radial-axial rolled blanks are pre-turned on vertical lathes, maintaining matching thickness parameters to absorb huge axial thrust jumps.

Process Radial CNC Ring Rolling
Applications Heavy Gearbox Columns
Request Custom RFQ
01

Billet Shearing & Volume Control

Raw alloy steel bar stocks are verified for chemistry and sheared into computed billet blocks. Exact volume calculations ensure zero flash waste and optimize starting density limits.

02

FEA Metal Flow Simulation

Before carving tooling, our design office runs DEFORM-3D simulations to validate temperature limits and metal flow. Prevents forging stress cracks and ensures clean grain orientation.

03

In-House VMC Die shop

Hot-forging closed dies are cut directly from 3D models using multi-axis high-speed Haas vertical machining centers (VMC). Limits prototyping loops to a tight 15-day cycle.

04

Hot Forging & Ring Rolling

Billets are induction-heated to 1150°C, pressed into punched pre-forms, and expanded dynamically on radial-axial CNC ring rolling mills. Refines structural steel grain flow along the hoops.

05

Metrology & Crack Audits

Finished components undergo normalizing or spheroidize annealing, CNC lathe coordinate check, non-destructive wet magnetic particle inspection (MPI), and spectrometer analysis.
